title.rendered: Can I Try Commercial Products Before Purchase?

content.rendered: All our open-source products do not require a license to operate, thus you can test and use them as you want. For commercial products, we are happy to provide you a trial license to test the full software for some days, until you are happy (e.g. 7-days testing license) and ready to get a full license. This is our standard way to let you test a product.
